meta.description: Create distinctive brands that customers choose because they believe there's no substitute, using Marty Neumeier's Brand Gap and Zag frameworks Use when: **Building a new brand** from scratch (startup, product, service); **Repositioning an existing brand** that's become commoditized; **Defining brand differentiation** when competitors all look the same; **Creating brand guidelines** for consistent execution; **Evaluating brand strength** through structured testing
